subject: general
question: What is India's rank in the Global Economic Freedom Index 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __105__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• India ranked 105th in Economic Freedom Index 2020.

 
 
• India's total score in this index was 56.5 and its overall score is increased by 1.3 points.
 
• Singapore topped the Economic Freedom Index 2020.
 
• Hong Kong for the first time secured 2nd rank since the 1st publication in 1995.
 
• North Korea ranked last, securing 180th rank.
 
 
 
• This index is based on 12 factors which have 4 pillars.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Index of Economic Freedom is an annual index and ranking which measure the degree of economic freedom in the world's nations.
 
• Heritage Foundation releases Index of Economic Freedom.
 
• **Heritage Foundation-** a conservative public policy research organization of The United States with its headquarter in Washington D.C. was founded in 1973 by **Edwin Feulner and Paul Weyrich.**
